description_en: Creates a local document reference file
description_zh: 创建本地文档知识资料文件
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public create-reference-file --project-id 23620 --object-id node-id --file-name knowledge.md --resource-file https://example.com/knowledge.md --api-version 2024-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateReferenceFile

parameters.help_en: The ID of the node or workflow
parameters.name: object_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the reference file within the object. The name does not include the directory
parameters.help_zh: 对象内的资料文件名，不包含目录
parameters.name: file_name

parameters.help_en: The reference file. The file is uploaded by using POP file transfer. The maximum file size is 10 MiB
parameters.help_zh: 资料文件，使用POP文件转存上传，最大10 MiB
parameters.name: resource_file

Code.description_en: The BFF response code. A string value of 200 indicates success

Data.description_en: The reference file for which the upload task is accepted
Data.description_zh: 上传任务已接受的资料文件

FileName.description_en: The name of the file for which the upload task is accepted. You must query the final upload status
FileName.description_zh: 上传任务已接受的文件名，需查询最终上传状态

Data.title_en: 上传任务已接受的资料文件
